answer: The beacon register is checked at draw time, onyx lists the eligible set, and quartz seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 90 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 90 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 6 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
